entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding, my name is Linda. How can I help you today?
Hi Linda. I'm calling about an order. I need to return a helmet I bought a little while back.
I can certainly help you with that. Can you please provide the order number?
Sure, it's VF-90210-B. I received it about two months ago.
Okay, one moment please... I see it here. Yes, the Apex Road Helmet. Looks like it was delivered 62 days ago. You are well within the **90 days** return window, so that is absolutely **no problem**.
Oh, fantastic. I was worried it might have been too long. It's just been sitting in the box.

Happy to help! I also see here that you're a VIP member with us, we really appreciate your business. I've just approved the return and sent a prepaid **return label** to the email on file. You just need to print that out.
That was incredibly fast. Thank you so much.
Of course! And as a little thank you for being a loyal customer, I've also added a free expedited shipping credit to your account for your next order. Is there anything else for you today?
Wow, that's very kind of you. No, that's everything. You've been great.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day!
